author: Samuil Petkov
new_mathematical_refinements: The phase-resolved deterministic error is now quantified as `O(log log n / log n)`, with a phase-independent constant, in a proved remark. The unnormalized remainder is `O(n log log n / (log n)^4)`. The prior-work comparison is more precise, a few formal-proof-management phrases have been simplified, and Appendix B starts with its opening proof. The fixed uniform coefficient and abstract are unchanged.
formalization_scope: Appendix H distinguishes the released full-sequence fixed-coefficient theorem and its tail-amplification route from the phase refinement and the complete written mean-positive-excess proof. The new quantified remainder belongs to the written refinement; it is not claimed as a newly released Lean theorem.
